newsitem.title: USA: Suit filed vs Sensormatic challenging proxy.
newsitem.headline: Suit filed vs Sensormatic challenging proxy.

text.p: Sensormatic Electronics Corp said on Tuesday a lawsuit had been filed against the company challenging the adequacy of disclosures made in Sensormatic's proxy statement.
Sensormatic, which said it had not been formally served with the complaint, said the lawsuit was brought on behalf of Marshall Wolf, who claimed to be a company shareholder.
The company said it planned to defend itself vigorously against the suit and that the proxy solicitation would continue.

The plaintiff challenged the company's proxy statement soliciting proxies to elect Ronald Assaf, chairman and former chief executive officer, and Arthur Milnes, a director, to new terms as directors and to approve an amendment to its 1995 stock incentive plan, Sensormatic said.

The plaintiff, who sought to invalidate the solicitation and to have the suit classified as a class action lawsuit, said the proxy statement failed to disclose certain admissions regarding prior accounting irregularities allegedly made by Assaf during his answer filed in a pending class action lawsuit in Florida, Sensormatic said.
The plaintiff also alleged that the proxy failed to describe the pending Florida lawsuit and another pending derivative lawsuit, Sensormatic said.
Sensormatic said the plaintiff also sought to void any election, and require a new election and a new proxy statement.
